source_documents.title: Excimer-to-excimer adiabatic ring opening of dipyrenylcyclobutane via predissociation

reference_evidence_units.quote: Electron absorption spectroscopy indicated the interaction of PVQ photochromes in the dyad DPVQ and pyrene substituents in the cyclobutane CB in the ground state, leading to the formation of π-stacked conformers.
reference_evidence_units.subject: DPVQ
reference_evidence_units.statement: Ground-state interaction of the two chromophores (π-stacked conformers).

reference_evidence_units.quote: excimers (‘excited dimers’) were experimentally observed both in the bichromophoric dyad and in the corresponding cyclobutane
reference_evidence_units.subject: DPVQ
reference_evidence_units.statement: Intramolecular excimer emission from the dyad.
